Independently confirmed from the record: after two automated attempts (QA-RCV-ZTGMTTTDB2U5YL and QA-RCV-ZTGMTTT83P06NC) GET /shipments still reported "dispatched" with deliveredAt null and receivedByUserId null for both. Filed as draft:receiving-a-shipment-fails-with-portal-command-envelope-malformed-and-reports-nothing. Because custody only moves on receipt, this blocks everything downstream - onward shipping, returns and dispensing are all unreachable through the dashboard until it is fixed. THE SPEC WAS REBUILT TWICE TO STOP IT PASSING FALSELY. It is now self-contained across three roles (import as the manufacturer, settle as the admin so Enforce does not block the dispatch, dispatch, then receive as the distributor) because the receiving list shows no SSCC in its rows and cannot be used to address a specific consignment. Two earlier judgements both produced a GREEN run on a shipment the platform had not touched: "the row no longer says Dispatched" (any other label, or an unpainted cell, counted as success) and "the row is gone from the pending list" (a filter that matched nothing looks identical to a completed receive). The verdict now comes from the shipment record and requires the status to leave dispatched AND deliveredAt AND receivedByUserId to be set.
